'''Daermor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Daermor system/Legends|Daermor system]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Auditor-General]] [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] conducted an audit there.
